notes: Gold11 parallel AI relabel of sc_07062eee17aa (38172000_01_SCAN_1.ply, Gold11 CG65CD575B1C); human gold untouched. Owner conventions: line locus = outer-skin apex (outer-skin patch pairs, --locus apex); a fold interrupted by a notch but folding the same two plates collinearly = one line spanning the fold; small formed bends count. Part (partial production stage): flat 1.5 mm web with 2 side flanges (90 deg, one notch each), 2 tabs lanced from windows (90 deg, the other way), and a 30 deg ear bend (vertical axis) at the -X end of each tab (CAD STEP F65_69 / F90_92, 30 deg, R 0.8). 6 formed bends; nothing else is formed (patch renders, YZ sections, 3 independent auditors). t 1.5 / Ri 0.8 = CAD nominal (measured twin offsets 1.41-1.52). Prep run once (no earlier prep of this scan existed). Tab-B fold and -Y flange fold use a plane_from_points web side because the single web patch is unusable there (tab B: web lies on both sides of the line so the patch side direction flips to the window side; -Y flange: the web edge strip is bowed ~1.8 mm along X and the patch's 0.6 mm plane gate drops it). r2 (2026-10-17): only B2 changed (web plane side refit, see B2 note); B1 and B3-B6 specs identical to r1.

bends.note: +Y side flange fold (human M02), 90 deg: web top skin 2 + flange outer faces 6 (long segment) and 14 (short segment); one line across the notch (fold support gap = the notch only). Auto extent = measured fold ends.

-Y side flange fold (human M05), 90 deg: web top skin as a plane side + flange outer faces 3 (long) and 11 (short); one line across the notch. r2 refit (r1 failed both verifiers: line ~0.9 mm median toward the virtual sharp). The measured outer apex bows ~3.5 mm along this 305 mm fold (web edge strip warped), and the default envelope apex rule puts a straight line on the outer envelope of a bowed arc (touching the skin only where the bow comes closest). Fix: (1) web plane fitted on a 100 mm ball seeded on the web top skin 14 mm from the fold (tol 0.9 mm, no grow) instead of the r1 160 mm ball over the whole bowed web; (2) apex_mode station_median, so the line runs through the middle of the measured apex. Extent = measured fold ends from YZ sections (unchanged from r1).

tab A fold (human M01, which ran 295 mm across flat web), 90 deg: web bottom skin 1 + tab A window-side face 10. Fold exists only along the tab (~78 mm, CAD 78 mm); it ends at the ear relief at the -X end. Auto extent.

tab B fold (human M04, which ran 300 mm across flat web), 90 deg: web bottom skin of the strip beside the fold as a plane side (patch 1 spans both sides of this line, so its side direction pointed into the window: mixed skin, coverage 0) + tab B window-side face 8. Fold ~78 mm. Auto extent.

ear A bend (missing from human gold; auditor-3 finding), ~31 deg about an axis perpendicular to the web, at the -X end of tab A: tab A outer face 10 + ear outer face 19. Spans the tab height above the main fold zone (~12 mm; CAD F65_69 12.7 mm). Auto extent.

ear B bend (missing from human gold; auditor-3 finding), ~31 deg about an axis in the tab-B plane, at the -X end of tab B: tab B outer face 8 + ear outer face 17. ~12 mm (CAD F90_92 12.7 mm). Auto extent.
